intro: Lake Ridge is a limited section of Rough Hollow made of lock and leave courtyard homes. CleanzATX schedules glass cleaning here around owners who travel or live elsewhere part of the year.

paragraphs: Lake Ridge is a section of courtyard homes in Rough Hollow, built so owners can lock the door and leave. Homes are limited in number and priced around $600K to $900K. It is not gated, and the Rough Hollow HOA covers the exterior areas.

Courtyard homes wrap around a private outdoor space. Glass faces inward onto the courtyard, and sliders open to a small patio. Windows are fewer and tend to be moderate in size. Most of the exterior upkeep falls to the owner, with the HOA handling the common areas.

sections.h2: What Lake Ridge windows deal with
paragraphs: A home that stands empty for weeks gets dusty. Cobwebs build undisturbed and pollen settles on sills. Courtyard glass catches the most dirt because it is sheltered, and a shaded patio gets spiders and bird droppings.

Sprinklers and rain on enclosed courtyards leave hard water spots with no wind to dry them. Spotted panes can be treated at $10 each. Tracks collect sand and dust, and a clean at $5 each makes sliders glide again.

Owners often ask us to coordinate by text. Exterior work needs no one at home as long as the courtyard gate is unlocked, and for interior work we arrange a time with you or with someone you trust. A plan means the visit repeats without you thinking about it.

Homes are smaller here, so a 2,400 sq ft home is about $240 for exterior windows and takes about two hours. A Every 2 Months plan takes 20% off, but most lock and leave owners choose Triannual at 15% off, with the free yearly screen clean included. A text photo within 7 days gets a free touch up when we are in the area.

faq.q: Will you clean the exterior if I am traveling?
faq.a: Yes, as long as the courtyard gate is unlocked and pets are inside. Interior work needs access, so we plan that for when you are back or with someone you trust.

faq.q: Does a plan make sense for a lock and leave home?
faq.a: Yes. A plan keeps recurring visits on the calendar and takes 10% to 20% off. Triannual and higher include extras.

faq.q: Do you clean the courtyard patio?
faq.a: Yes. Patios are cleaned by hand so water stays off furniture and glass. Pricing is by square footage.

faq.q: Will you text when the work is finished?
faq.a: Yes. We text when we are done and you can send a photo within 7 days if anything needs a touch up.
The HOA covers shared spaces. Your windows, sliders and screens are yours, and we clean those.
